title: The Muzzle Comes with Terms
setup: The scout protocol reveals the incoming vessel will automatically reactivate old habitat controls unless the city authenticates an independent status message. Muzzle's interface can open the required channel.
escalation: Muzzle demands authority in exchange for cooperation. Neon offers a different design: use the interface as a supervised translator while multiple public keys authorize each outgoing command. CARETAKER warns that its old classification could provoke a containment response, but cannot decide for them.
resolution: Muzzle accepts the limited role when he learns the humans also classify him as a managed animal. The city sends a collectively authorized declaration of personhood, its charter and verified evidence of self-government. The interface's private override channel is physically disconnected for this session.
continuity: Muzzle's device is not removed or redesigned; the external relay and authorization process change. Cooperation is pragmatic and supervised, not absolution. The humans have received the message, but their response remains unknown.
comedy: The first draft contains forty-seven uses of the word meow and one legally decisive footnote.
ending_hook: The vessel acknowledges receipt and continues its approach without stating whether it accepts the charter.
status: Development draft — not scripted or recorded
